Downtown & Riverfront.name: Downtown & Riverfront
Downtown & Riverfront.description: Cumberland River core spanning Broadway honky-tonk blocks, the East Bank stadium district, and high-rise hotel and multifamily redevelopment.

The Gulch & Midtown.name: The Gulch & Midtown
The Gulch & Midtown.description: Transit-adjacent mixed-use corridor between the Gulch towers, Music Row, and the Vanderbilt-adjacent Midtown bar and residential strip.

East Nashville & Five Points.name: East Nashville & Five Points
East Nashville & Five Points.description: River-east bungalow neighborhoods anchored by the Five Points commercial node with steady residential infill and renovation demand.

Belmont & Hillsboro Village.name: Belmont & Hillsboro Village
Belmont & Hillsboro Village.description: University-district market between Belmont and Vanderbilt campuses with student rental demand, retail frontage, and older-stock renovation.

Antioch & Southeast Corridor.name: Antioch & Southeast Corridor
Antioch & Southeast Corridor.description: Southeast Davidson growth belt along Antioch Pike and the Cullum/Percy Priest corridors with townhome and big-box repositioning activity.
